$comment: Maps SharePoint subfolders under sourceRoot to local public/images/ destinations. Edit this file (no code change) to add/remove folders, retire the year (e.g. change sourceRoot to '1 photos/2027 Photos'), or repoint a destination. Each sync resets its dest dir before writing, so removing an entry here will leave files in place on disk — delete manually if you actually want them gone.
